beat: Friday mall: donuts, Sharmi and Raj reunion, Saturday dinner invitation

lines.original: Being Friday..... John was signing off early today.... Dhika had planned to visit the super store to buy home needs and had already informed John that they had to go on Friday..
lines.local: Friday tha, toh John aaj jaldi office se nikal raha tha. Dhika ne ghar ke saamaan ke liye supermarket jaana plan kiya tha aur pehle hi John se Friday saath chalne ki baat ki thi.

lines.original: Dropping Pappu and Aunty in a near by park... John and Dhika reached the mall...
lines.local: Pappu aur Aunty ko paas ke park mein chhodkar John aur Dhika mall pahunche.

lines.original: Every time Dhika and John come here to this mall..... Dhika had a habit of going straight to the top floor.... to the donut stall. She came here so often that as soon as she approached... the girl who works there, pick the same cream coated donut and hands it out to her smiling.
lines.local: Har baar is mall aakar Dhika seedha top floor ke donut stall jaati thi. Itni regular thi ki wahan ki ladki use dekhte hi wahi cream-coated donut muskuraakar nikaal deti thi.

lines.original: John grabbed a coffee and paid the stall girl...... and they both turned to find a seat.....
lines.local: John ne coffee li, stall wali ko paise diye aur dono baithne ki jagah dhoondhne mude.

lines.original: Dhika saw a familiar face and pulled John in one hand and proceeded towards it.....
lines.local: Dhika ko ek pehchana chehra dikh gaya; usne ek haath se John ko kheencha aur us taraf chal di.

lines.original: The familiar face saw her too......
lines.local: Udhar se bhi pehchaan ho gayi.

lines.original: Dhika: heyyyyy....... sharmi darling........ she hugged sharmi....
lines.local: Dhika: Heyyy, Sharmi darling! Usne Sharmi ko hug kiya.

lines.original: Sharmi: heeyyyy sweetie.... she hugged back.......
lines.local: Sharmi: Hey sweetie! Usne bhi wapas hug diya.

lines.original: Sharmi and Raj were waiting in the food court, with ice cream. Raj loves movies and being Friday,... he couldn't wait to watch one.. almost every week and often multiples times a week, Raj and Sharmi would come for a movie.....
lines.local: Sharmi aur Raj food court mein ice cream ke saath baithe the. Raj ko films ka bada shauk hai; Friday ko woh movie dekhne ko bechain rehta aur dono lagbhag har hafte, kabhi kai baar, cinema jaate hain.

lines.original: Raj: Hello John... nice to meet you again... he gave a light hug with a pat to John...
lines.local: Raj: Hello John, dobara milkar achha laga! Usne halka hug aur peeth par thapki di.

lines.original: John: Hey Raj... he hugged back...
lines.local: John: Hey Raj! Usne bhi hug kiya.

lines.original: John towered a few inches above Raj... John greeted Raj and turned towards Dhika and Sharmi.....
lines.local: John height mein Raj se kuch inch lamba tha. Use greet karke Dhika aur Sharmi ki taraf muda.

lines.original: As soon as he turned.... Sharmi pushed Dhika aside and went to hug John... She gave John a modest hug and winked at him.... and then both Sharmi and John turned towards Dhika....
lines.local: John ke mudte hi Sharmi ne Dhika ko halka side kar diya aur John ko modest hug dekar wink kiya. Phir dono Dhika ki taraf mud gaye.

lines.original: Standing to the side of Raj.... she wondered why all three are looking at her..... with just Raj smiling politely just as she saw him as he saw her, where as Sharmi gave a sort of cunning smile and John a small unclear grinn....
lines.local: Raj ke paas khadi Dhika hairaan thi ki teeno use kyun dekh rahe hain. Raj hamesha ki tarah politely muskura raha tha; Sharmi ki smile shararti aur John ki halki grin samajh nahi aa rahi thi.

lines.original: Now with Raj hugging John... and Dhika hugging Sharmi......... and Sharmi hugging John.... Dhika was being noticed how she would greet Raj.......
lines.local: Raj ne John ko hug kiya, Dhika ne Sharmi ko, Sharmi ne John ko—ab sab dekh rahe the ki Dhika Raj ko kaise greet karegi.

lines.original: Feeling the peer pressure... she felt a little blush and suddenly, like a college girl... she put a hand out to shook Raj's hands...
lines.local: Thoda peer pressure aur sharm mehsoos karke Dhika ne college girl jaisi hichkichahat se Raj ki taraf handshake ke liye haath badha diya.

lines.original: Both John and Sharmi started laughing out loud.... where as Raj just shook her hands and smiled politely....Dhika gave a stern look at John...
lines.local: John aur Sharmi zor se hans pade. Raj ne politely handshake kiya aur smile di; Dhika ne John ko sakht nazron se dekha.

lines.original: John: hehe.. it is still a big step... he teased....
lines.local: John: Hehe, chalo, yeh bhi bada step hai! Usne chheda.

lines.original: Sharmi: hehe.... I don't know if you have hugged anyone other than your precious John...
lines.local: Sharmi: Hehe, pata nahi tumne apne pyare John ke alawa kisi ko hug bhi kiya hai ya nahi.

lines.original: Dhika just stood there with an awkward smile.....
lines.local: Dhika bas awkward smile ke saath khadi rahi.

lines.original: Raj: trying to aid her... come sit Dhika... don't mind her..
lines.local: Raj madad ko: Aao Dhika, baitho. Iski baat ka bura mat maano.

lines.original: Raj: seems like we always meet while having food....
lines.local: Raj: Lagta hai jab bhi milte hain, khaana khaate hue hi milte hain.

lines.original: Sharmi: yeah.... perhaps we should all get together and eat at home..
lines.local: Sharmi: Haan, shayad kabhi sabko ghar par saath khana chahiye.

lines.original: Dhika: yes darling... we should definitly do that... she said looking at John....
lines.local: Dhika John ki taraf dekhte hue: Haan darling, bilkul karna chahiye.

lines.original: Raj: John.... if you guys are free tomorrow... it would be wonderful if you can join us for dinner at our home.....
lines.local: Raj: John, agar kal free ho toh hamare ghar dinner par aaoge toh bahut achha lagega.

lines.original: John too liked the plan, perhaps because of why Sharmi keeps winking at him... Dhika wanted to too.. so the plan was settled that both of them would visit Raj's house tomorrow....
lines.local: John ko bhi plan pasand aaya—shayad Sharmi ke baar-baar wink ki wajah se bhi. Dhika bhi jaana chahti thi; tay hua ki kal dono Raj ke ghar jaayenge.

lines.original: For now... John and Dhika said their byes after finishing the donut and coffee and left to finish shopping and head home......
lines.local: Filhaal donut aur coffee khatam karke John aur Dhika bye bolkar shopping niptaane aur ghar jaane nikal gaye.
